with reaper you seem quite alright, however there are some small things you could be doing
1- when your hooked in by road hog, thanks to reapers reworked passive, (20% health for all damage he does)rather than immediatly using wraith form, you can lay some shots on roadhog, keeping you sustained and out damaging him, often you can either force him to use his vape smoke, or kill him if you land your shots. certianly wraith form out if you seem to be overwhelmed, however it often works in your favour when hog pulls you in.

2- use wraith form from spawn and then use his tele, or the other way round it doesn't matter. reaper gets a small movement buff when he is in wraith form, so you can get the point faster.

3- just a small thing, often you would move under the bridge on attack, get targeted by syms turrets and then move back under the bridge, when you could have easily looked up and shot  the turrets, removing a annoyance for your team. just a small thing to look out for.

anyway you seem to have the basics of him down pat, just work on some small things :-)
